sqlMap.select:
/*BizDescMatch.selectReportCandidates*/ SELECT R.FIS_YEAR AS FIS_YEAR , R.BGT_DGR AS BGT_DGR , R.REPORT_CD AS REPORT_CD , R.REPORT_DETL_CD AS REPORT_DETL_CD , R.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AS TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , R.TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ AS TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ , NVL(R.DEMAND_CONT, '') AS DEMAND_CONT , NVL(R.EXAM_CONT, '') AS EXAM_CONT , NVL(R.REFLECT_FG, '') AS REFLECT_FG , NVL(R.SRCH_VAL, '') AS SRCH_VAL , NVL(R.INVEST_PLAN, '') AS INVEST_PLAN , C.DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD , D.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM , C.DBIZ_CD AS DBIZ_CD , B.DBIZ_NM AS DBIZ_NM , C.TE_MNG_MOK_CD AS TE_MNG_MOK_CD , NVL(M.TE_MNG_MOK_NM, '') AS TE_MNG_MOK_NM , C.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AS DGRCOMPO_ID FROM
TB_REPORT010 R
TB_REPORT020 R
INNER JOIN TB_DGRCOMPO C ON C.FIS_YEAR = R.FIS_YEAR AND C.BGT_DGR = R.BGT_DGR AND C.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = R.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AND C.COMPO_LEVEL = '1' INNER JOIN TB_DGRDEPT D ON D.FIS_YEAR = C.FIS_YEAR AND D.BGT_DGR = C.BGT_DGR AND D.DEPT_CD = C.DEPT_CD INNER JOIN TB_DGRBIZ B ON B.FIS_YEAR = C.FIS_YEAR AND B.BGT_DGR = C.BGT_DGR AND B.DBIZ_CD = C.DBIZ_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DGRTEMNGMOK M ON M.FIS_YEAR = C.FIS_YEAR AND M.BGT_DGR = C.BGT_DGR AND M.TE_MNG_MOK_CD = C.TE_MNG_MOK_CD WHERE R.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND R.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# AND R.REPORT_CD = #reportCd#
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USERDEPT Z WHERE Z.USER_ID = #userId# AND Z.DEPT_CD = C.DEPT_CD )
AND D.DEPT_NM LIKE '%' || #deptNmLike# || '%'
AND B.DBIZ_NM LIKE '%' || #dbizNmLike# || '%'
ORDER BY D.DEPT_NM, B.DBIZ_NM, C.TE_MNG_MOK_CD

/*BizDescMatch.selectFileList - 회계년도+예산차수+실국 (조서구분 무시: 경상·투자 파일 모두)*/ SELECT BIZDESC_FILE_ID , FIS_YEAR , BGT_DGR , REPORT_CD , OFFICE_CD , OFFICE_NM , ATCH_FILE_ID , ORG_FILE_NM , STRE_FILE_NM , FILE_STRE_COURS , PARSE_JSON_PATH , BIZ_COUNT , REGI_ID , REGI_DATE , MODI_ID , MODI_DATE FROM TB_BIZDESC_FILE WHERE FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr#
AND OFFICE_CD = 'ALL'
AND (OFFICE_CD = #officeCd# OR OFFICE_CD = 'ALL')
ORDER BY REGI_DATE DESC

/*BizDescMatch.selectFile*/ SELECT BIZDESC_FILE_ID , FIS_YEAR , BGT_DGR , REPORT_CD , OFFICE_CD , OFFICE_NM , ATCH_FILE_ID , ORG_FILE_NM , STRE_FILE_NM , FILE_STRE_COURS , PARSE_JSON_PATH , BIZ_COUNT , REGI_ID , REGI_DATE FROM TB_BIZDESC_FILE WHERE BIZDESC_FILE_ID = #bizdescFileId#

/*BizDescMatch.selectMatch*/ SELECT FIS_YEAR , BGT_DGR , REPORT_CD , TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , BIZDESC_FILE_ID , BIZ_SEQ , BIZ_NM , DEPT_NM , MATCH_SCORE , REGI_ID , REGI_DATE FROM TB_BIZDESC_MATCH WHERE FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# AND REPORT_CD = #reportCd# AND TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = #teBgtCompoId#
sqlMap.update: /*BizDescMatch.updateMatch*/ UPDATE TB_BIZDESC_MATCH SET BIZDESC_FILE_ID = #bizdescFileId# , BIZ_SEQ = #bizSeq# , BIZ_NM = #bizNm# , DEPT_NM = #deptNm# , MATCH_SCORE = #matchScore# , REGI_ID = #regiId# , REGI_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# AND REPORT_CD = #reportCd# AND TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = #teBgtCompoId#
sqlMap.delete: /*BizDescMatch.deleteMatch*/ DELETE FROM TB_BIZDESC_MATCH WHERE FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# AND REPORT_CD = #reportCd# AND TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = #teBgtCompoId#
